deviations.what: The bibliography-file path (T016) accepts a CSL-JSON file rather than BibTeX/RIS/EndNote.
deviations.why: django-literature's own add-without-leaving-the-page mechanism parses those three formats client-side, in a bundled JS library this repository doesn't own; no server-side parser is an available dependency (pybtex/citeproc-py are transitive-only, and deptry DEP003 refuses a direct import of either). CSL-JSON is read with the stdlib json module and passed straight to LiteratureItem.objects.create(item=...), the same shape the model already derives type/title/issued/citation_key from.

deviations.what: Assessors are credited as dataset contributors under the FairDMRoles role DataCollector, not DataCurator (the retired view's choice).
deviations.why: DataCurator is now the name of this feature's own Data Curator portal group; carrying it forward as a contributor-role label would misleadingly claim portal-role membership rather than record what an assessor actually did. DataCollector is the closest existing FairDMRoles concept to carrying out an assessment.

deviations.what: The uploader's object permissions are granted via fairdm.utils.permissions.assign_all_model_perms (every Dataset permission) rather than the five named permissions DatasetCreateView.form_valid grants via guardian.shortcuts.assign_perm.
deviations.why: django-guardian is a transitive dependency only; deptry DEP003 refuses a direct guardian import from project/review/. assign_all_model_perms wraps the same guardian call through fairdm, a direct dependency, and is the same helper the retired create view already called once per reviewer — now called once for uploaded_by instead, which is the brief's actual correction.

deviations.what: T017's tests call ReviewCreateView.as_view() directly via RequestFactory rather than through reverse("review-create"); the route itself is registered in T019, not pulled forward into T017's commit.
deviations.why: Unlike US-1's list view (D15), T017's acceptance is about POST/database behaviour, not a rendered response, so no resolvable URL is needed to prove it. This keeps T017 and T019 independent of each other's landing order instead of repeating D15's forced reordering.

concerns: docs/data_models/ghfdb-erd.md and the guides carry no changes: US-2 added no new model fields (uploaded_by/state/decided_by/decided_at/decision_comment were already added and documented in US-1/T010b), so the documentation check's existing coverage needed no updates. Confirmed rather than assumed: tests/test_docs/ (305 tests) passed unchanged.
